checked_sources: Independent exact rational covariance from explicit vertex multisets for m=2,3,4
correctness.rationale: The vertices of the standard coordinate partial permutohedron P(m,n), n>=m>=2, are disjoint rank-k orbits consisting of permutations of (n,n-1,...,n-k+1,0,...,0), of sizes w_k=m!/(m-k)!. Under the uniform vertex law the covariance is S_m invariant and has one scalar eigenvalue on span(1) and one on 1-perp. The parallel eigenvalue is Var(S_k)/m; the transverse eigenvalue follows from total norm Q_k and trace. The deficiency D=m-k has exact truncated Poisson(1) weights 1/(d! Z_m), so its first four factorial moments give explicit A_m,B_m,C_m for m(m-1)(lambda_parallel-lambda_perp)=A_m*n^2+B_m*n+C_m. A_m>0 and the quadratic at n=m is negative for all m>=2; thus exactly one root tau_m above m determines the eigenspace crossing. Scaling n=m^2*z gives the limiting root 1/2+1/sqrt(3). The real threshold need not be an integer, and the claim is only uniform discrete vertices in standard Euclidean coordinates. Independent exact fractional covariance reconstruction for (m,n)=(2,3),(3,5),(4,8) gave lambda_parallel<lambda_perp as asserted.
residual_risks: The finite checks do not prove all m; the orbit-moment identity, coefficient sign argument, and asymptotic convergence are the required infinite proof.

evidence: Behrend et al. Proposition 2.7 gives all vertices; the 2026 Löwner threshold is for n-dimensional contact measure over two orbits and a different optimization.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The earlier vertex theorem supplies weights used to calculate moments but does not imply the quadratic sign reversal without the distributional moment computation. The Löwner result uses optimized enclosing ellipsoid, not actual full uniform-vertex covariance.

originality.rationale: The actual polytope and all vertex orbits were published by Heuer–Striker and Behrend et al. A related quadratic threshold is for an enclosing Löwner ellipsoid with a particular contact measure; another published result studies a different high-dimensional partial-permutation matching polytope. Neither gives covariance under the full uniform vertex measure on P(m,n), nor its exact changing top eigenspace.
residual_risks: Equivalent exact uniform-vertex moments could exist in unindexed work under inertia, second moment, or combinatorial orbit terminology.

source_inspections.title: A quadratic contact threshold for the Löwner ellipsoid of partial permutohedra

value.rationale: The exact crossing shows a geometric principal-component transition in a natural polytope while its combinatorial type stays fixed. The full uniform vertex measure and normalization are intrinsically motivated; a sharp tau_m~(1/2+1/sqrt(3))*m^2 is a genuine all-dimensional structural fact rather than a routine orbit recount.
residual_risks: Only the standard Euclidean coordinate model and equiprobable vertices are covered; no volume covariance or general affine-invariant claim.

limitations: The asymptotic threshold is established analytically; small-size tests supplement it. Novelty depends on absence of an equivalent prior uniform-vertex inertia formula rather than on absence of similar named ellipsoid thresholds.
